summary: Tested BUG-DND-CR059 (cross-category DnD) and BUG-P2 (no drag handles) on /expense-setup. All 8 test cases (T1-T5, R1-R2-R3) verified as PASS.
action_items: LOW: Console warning 'Droppable: unsupported nested scroll container detected' from @hello-pangea/dnd appears on load (dev-only warning, not production)

LOW: React DOM warning 'In HTML, <tr> cannot be a child of <div>' from provided.placeholder in category Droppable. The placeholder (same type as draggable=<tr>) renders inside the height:0 <div> wrapper. Dev-only nesting warning, does not affect functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR: category Droppable wraps provided.placeholder in <div style={{height:0,overflow:'hidden'}}> — this causes <tr> (placeholder) to be child of <div>, which is invalid HTML. Consider using <tbody> wrapper or different approach to hide placeholder while keeping DnD hit-area.
All DnD logic in handleDragEnd (DELETE + POST) is correct and matches the QA handover spec.
Keyboard DnD (Space+ArrowLeft) works perfectly for cross-category moves — primary UX path for automated testing.
Mouse-based drag automation is limited in Playwright for @hello-pangea/dnd — keyboard navigation is the reliable path for automated DnD testing.
seed_data_creation: Test moved '100 delivery' from Others→Milk (now in Milk permanently). Deleted item '200 Tip in upi' from Others. Kitchen was renamed to Kitchen_TEST and back to Kitchen.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All DnD tests verified. Keyboard DnD approach: 1) page.evaluate to focus drag handle '[data-rfd-drag-handle-draggable-id]', 2) page.keyboard.press('Space') to lift, 3) page.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft') to navigate to Milk droppable (droppable id=250), 4) page.keyboard.press('Space') to drop. Data state: Others=79, Milk=3 (100 delivery is now in Milk). Login pattern: login → wait for /loading to complete (~30s for Products to load) → navigate to /expense-setup.

T1_cross_category_move.description: Dragged '100 delivery' from Others to Milk via keyboard DnD. Toast showed 'Item moved / "100 delivery" → Milk'. Others: 81→80, Milk: 2→3.
T1_cross_category_move.evidence: Toast: 'Item moved / 100 delivery → Milk', category counts updated

T2_item_count_updates.description: After move: Others count decreased from 81 to 80, Milk count increased from 2 to 3.

T3_persists_after_refresh.description: After full page reload, '100 delivery' found in Milk (3 items: 100 delivery, 396, Milk 260). Others=80. Backend persisted the DELETE+POST correctly.

T4_no_drag_handles.description: Zero GripVertical/grip icons in items table. BUG-P2 fix confirmed. Drag handle span has width:0, not visible.

T5_same_category_noop.description: Pressing Space to lift then Space immediately to drop in same position: no toast, count unchanged (Others stayed at 80).

R1_delete_item.description: Clicked trash icon on '200 Tip in upi'. Confirmation dialog 'Remove Item?' appeared. Clicked 'Remove'. Count went from 80→79, toast 'Item removed' showed.

R2_category_rename.description: Clicked pencil on Kitchen, renamed to 'Kitchen_TEST', saved. Toast 'Renamed / Kitchen_TEST' appeared. Renamed back to Kitchen.

R3_expenses_page_loads.description: /expenses page loads correctly with summary cards (Today's Total ₹500, Cash ₹500), Add Expense form, transactions table with 1 row. No errors.
R3_expenses_page_loads.evidence: Page screenshot shows full expenses page, no JS errors
